title: One cache miss, a million queries
description: How a single expiring cache key can take down your database. The thundering herd explained, with real outages and seven fixes from request coalescing to probabilistic early expiry.
coverAlt: An ink-drawn hourglass running out on warm paper, with a stampede of small arrows pouring out of it toward a single cracked database cylinder

title: 10:00:00 AM — India's daily DDoS
description: Why IRCTC struggles every morning at Tatkal time. A system design look at synchronized crowds, segment-based seat inventory, payment pile-ups and the bots racing you for a berth.
coverAlt: An ink-drawn railway clock stuck at ten o'clock on warm paper, with a crowd of dots rushing toward a single rust-coloured train berth

title: One line broke the internet
description: Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, Facebook and AWS were each taken down by a tiny change that shipped everywhere at once. What went wrong, the pattern they share, and how to ship config safely.
coverAlt: An ink-drawn globe on warm paper wrapped in a single rust-coloured line of code, with a crack spreading from one point across every continent

title: Bad neighbours — why Vercel puts your project on .app, not .com
description: Why your deploy lands on vercel.app and not vercel.com, and how cookies, SameSite and webhooks go wrong when apps share a parent domain like app1 and app2.
coverAlt: A row of ink-drawn houses on warm paper; two share one roof and pass a cookie between them, while the rest sit behind their own fences

title: Design a streaming platform for 100 million viewers — from first principles to AWS
description: A step-by-step system design workshop: size 100 million viewers, choose Java, Spring Boot and Go services, map them to AWS, and test the failure paths.
coverAlt: An ink-and-rust network blueprint connecting one stream to 100 million viewers on warm paper

title: Inside the surge — how JioHotstar scales live streaming
description: A visual case study of JioHotstar-scale streaming, from CDN delivery and adaptive video to match-day traffic spikes, autoscaling, and failure recovery.
coverAlt: A cricket stadium in ink on warm paper with rust-colored delivery routes spreading toward viewers

title: Everything this blog can do
description: A tour of the building blocks — diagrams, charts, videos, callouts and code — written as plain Markdown.
coverAlt: Ink sketch of a mountain range

title: Designing Uber, end to end
description: A detailed system design of a ride-hailing platform, from a driver's GPS ping to the payment captured after the trip, with the trade-offs at every step.
coverAlt: Hexagonal city grid with a driver and a rider joined by a dotted route

title: Twelve noon, sold out — how BookMyShow handles concert rushes and seat booking
description: A visual case study of BookMyShow-scale ticketing, from virtual waiting rooms and seat holds to payments, bots, and the day-to-day movie booking rush.
coverAlt: An ink-drawn ticket stub on warm paper, with a dotted queue leading to a small grid of rust-colored seats

title: HLS video streaming from scratch with FFmpeg and Java
description: Turn one MP4 into an adaptive, encrypted, CDN-friendly stream. Bitrate ladders, segment sizes, ABR, AES-128 and a Java pipeline that runs it all, with charts at every step.
coverAlt: A film strip split into segments that fan out into four quality lanes, with a player path hopping between them

title: From .java to the CPU: how Java code actually runs
description: Follow a real program from source code to bytecode, class loading, stack frames, JIT compilation and garbage collection—with diagrams and experiments you can run yourself.
coverAlt: A diagram tracing Java source through bytecode and the JVM to native CPU instructions
